services.name: Classes
services.desc: NCA provides ongoing skills development in Clay and 2D mediums. Classes generally run 6-8 weeks in 2-month blocks. We also offer one-time courses, an excellent way to try different artistic mediums or enjoy an evening with friends. You can sign up for classes individually or as a group. services.name: Private Party
services.desc: Book a private class for you and your friends. Our instructors will walk you through making a bowl on the potters' wheel. Once you have made it, we fire it for you and glaze it in the colour of your choice. Finished items will be ready for pickup within two weeks. 8 people max; children must be 12 or older. It may take us two days to find an instructor for your group. If you have requested a booking and do not hear back, please check your junk mail or send us an email Refunds are available if you cancel 24 hours before your booking. services.name: Camp
services.desc: Young artist 8-14 years old will learn about art through a variety of fun projects in our studio. Let your child experience art of all kinds! Our art studio is a place for imaginations to run wild and creativity to happen in a positive, outside-the-box thinking and fun way. Your child will explore different forms of art from tactile projects in clay to working with paint, drawing tools, mixed media on paper, canvas and more. Each session will include a project and creative exercises where the topics are suitable for all ages and genders. Our space is a safe environment that encourages children to express their creative minds while receiving instruction and guidance from experienced artist

services.name: Make a bowl: every other Sat
services.desc: Come in and get a bit muddy and meet some rad people. We will teach you how to make a bowl on the potter's wheel from start to finish. No experience necessary! Then we glaze it for you and you get to come pick up your masterpiece a couple weeks later. Clay does not stain, but wear clothes you can get messy in. Change of plans? Tansfers or full refunds will be given up to 7 day prior to your class. After that refunds minus $20 are given if we fill your slot Refunds are available 14 days ahead of your class. Transfers can be made 7 days ahead of class
